name: player_keeptradecut_value year split with an as_of_month_day anchor
description: Baseline emission for the as_of_month_day param under a year row axis. Pins that the boundary is the doubly-clamped make_date expression anchored on opening_days.year rather than date_trunc('day', opening_days.opening_day), and that everything around it is untouched: the opening_days join stays, both opening_days.year predicates stay, the 30-day recency floor is still derived from the clamped boundary, and the single as_of_observed_at lookup still serves the axis. Regenerating this fixture against an emitter that dropped the param would produce the opening-day boundary instead.
expected_query: with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023,2024,2025]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t2802b3532d50293f7240efc7336cbdb7"."keeptradecut_value" AS "player_keeptradecut_value_0", "player_years"."year", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "opening_days" on "opening_days"."year" = "player_years"."year" left join "keeptradecut_valuations" as "t2802b3532d50293f7240efc7336cbdb7" on "t2802b3532d50293f7240efc7336cbdb7"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "t2802b3532d50293f7240efc7336cbdb7"."is_superflex" = true and opening_days.year = (player_years.year) and "t2802b3532d50293f7240efc7336cbdb7"."observed_at" = (select MAX(observed_at) from "keeptradecut_valuations" where "pid" = player.pid and "is_superflex" = true and "keeptradecut_value" is not null and "observed_at" <= LEAST(LEAST(make_date((opening_days.year) + 0, 3, 1) + (1 - 1) * interval '1 day', make_date((opening_days.year) + 0, 3, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::timestamptz, now()) and "observed_at" > (LEAST(LEAST(make_date((opening_days.year) + 0, 3, 1) + (1 - 1) * interval '1 day', make_date((opening_days.year) + 0, 3, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::timestamptz, now()) - interval '30 days')) group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t2802b3532d50293f7240efc7336cbdb7"."keeptradecut_value", "player_years"."year", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 10
